what_happened: Task 677's description item (2) literally directs sapience-remember.sh and the postflight pass to send project_cid on POST /ingest-kos. sf1-engine's integration/project-link.md section 10 Ruling 7 (cross-harness agreed, cited by this repo's own linked-repo-write-policy.md) forbids any write attaching a verified project_cid from an autonomous task run unless its origin is 'typed', and keeps that gate closed until two named leak paths close (neither closed yet). The completing postflight pass is exactly the non-typed, autonomous-dispatch write surface the ruling targets, and brain_server.py's _ingest_kos handler confirms a verified project_cid write overwrites ko['author'] with the real member's own display name and delivers live (follow:true) to the collaborator with no suggestion-lane gating -- so implementing item (2) as literally written would misattribute agent-authored notes as the human member's own typed decisions. The existing, already-committed design (plain project key field, never project_cid) sits below this gate and should be preserved; only the read-side use of project_cid (item 3) is explicitly carved out by the ruling as safe for an autonomous dispatch.

Both app-side dependencies the task 677 description names (open_mvp_flags_and_create_linked_team_project, repo_link_code_onto_release_line) are not complete: the former is an open specs/TODO.md item in sapience-app and the latter is ROADMAP-listed as HOLD. fly.toml deploys REPO_LINK_FOR = "" (off for every account). This repo also carries no .sapience/project.json binding yet. Every live-server-dependent behavior in items 2-3 (search-side project_cid gating, write-side project_cid verification/project_rejected) is therefore untestable against the real server today and must be verified against a stub, exactly as the task description itself anticipates.

This plan's doc phase must edit agent-system/extensions/sapience/context/project/sapience/domain/per-repo-scoping.md and index-entries.json, both of which are in concurrent sibling task 682's declared implement-phase file_scope this same cycle. Declared anyway (the work requires them) with a Risks row and an explicit re-read-immediately-before-editing / stage-own-hunks-only instruction in the phase tasks.

The research report's Ruling 7 finding (write-side project_cid conflicts with a cross-harness-agreed governance ruling) let this plan state a clean scope exclusion for task item (2) instead of planning a change that would have had to be reverted; it also named the exact stub/curl-shadow test harness (test-sapience-capture.sh build_curl_stub) and the CORE_TEST_SUBJECT_MODE=source-store escape, so no whole-tree regeneration claim is needed.
